evidence.AC1: POST /todos {"title":"past","dueDate":"2020-01-01"} returned 201 with dueDate "2020-01-01". POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The value is a plain YYYY-MM-DD date with no time.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/2 {"dueDate":"2019-05-05"} returned 200 and the dueDate changed. PATCH /todos/2 {"dueDate":null} returned 200 with dueDate null, so the date was removed.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30" returned 400. POST with dueDate "14.10.2026" returned 400. PATCH with dueDate "2026-02-30" returned 400.
evidence.AC4: Today in UTC is 2026-10-14. I created todos with these due dates: past (2020-01-01), future (2099-01-01, later changed to null), today (2026-10-14), none (no date) and pastdone (2020-01-01, then marked done). GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the 'past' todo. The future, today, no-date and done todos were excluded, and the done one showed overdue:false.
evidence.AC5: The page at / listed each todo that has a due date with 'Fällig: <date>', for example 'Fällig: 2020-01-01' and 'Fällig: 2026-10-14'. Todos without a date showed no date.
evidence.AC6: In the page snapshot only the overdue todo 'past' carried the text 'überfällig'. The today, no-date and done-with-past-date todos did not.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled 'nur überfällige'. I clicked it and the list was reduced to only the 'past' todo, with its 'überfällig' marker.
